name: Evatec AG
capabilities: BAK Evaporators for Power Device and MEMS
summary: Evatec AG is a leading provider of thin film deposition equipment, offering advanced production tools and processes for the semiconductor industry. Their solutions are integral to manufacturing next-generation devices across various applications, including power management, RF/5G, and advanced packaging. Evatec's technologies support innovations in smart wearables, 5G networks, and high-performance computing.
